Paragraph: "I am the one who obtained servitude by the justness of this faithful and knowledgeable one, and his younger brother, by name I am named as Lakshmana...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Introducing himself and his role in relation to Rama.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana defines his identity through devoted service to his elder brother.
Outcome/Resolution: Establishes Lakshmana's total loyalty and humility.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Ego: Humility and subordination of personal identity for a noble bond

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bhratru-bhakti (devoted service to an elder brother/mentor)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Lakshmana takes pride in selfless service (seva) to righteousness embodied in Rama.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reflects healthy subordination of ego in service of a shared, higher purpose.
